admission.justification: Loading at the first deadline turns slow host drawing into a destructive retry loop.

applicability: Recovery and URL steering of an existing frame.
conditions: A missing ready or open answer is followed by ping with its own deadline.
Explicit unsupported open-agent capability is handled separately.
exclusions: Initial mount and unrelated native application reconnects are not selection reloads.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/paseoFrameLateAnswer.test.tsx › "loads the frame once when the application answers nothing at all, and switches by message again", "asks by a ping at the deadline and loads nothing: the application answers with its late ready report" / "… its pong", "counts the channel as unavailable only when that ping stays unanswered too, and then loads nothing more"; dashboard/src/cockpit/PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx › "keeps the frame, shows the banner after an unanswered ping, and shows executions by URL"

statement: The frame's document loads again only when a ping stayed unanswered for the deadline (after a load's missing ready report, or after a request's missing answer), on Retry, and when a host that was gone is back; a plug-in that says it cannot show an agent on request has every agent loaded by its URL; after such a load the next change is a switch again.
